scripts.start: docker compose up -d && pm2 start ecosystem.config.js
scripts.start:core: pm2 start ecosystem.config.js --only $(bun scripts/pm2-name.ts api),$(bun scripts/pm2-name.ts worker)
scripts.stop: pm2 stop ecosystem.config.js && docker compose down
scripts.stop:core: pm2 stop $(bun scripts/pm2-name.ts api) $(bun scripts/pm2-name.ts worker)
scripts.reload: docker compose up -d && pm2 reload ecosystem.config.js --update-env
scripts.postinstall: bun run submodules && bun run extensions:install
scripts.sandbox:build:docker: docker build --platform linux/$(uname -m | sed 's/x86_64/amd64/' | sed 's/aarch64/arm64/') -t tau-sandbox:latest -f apps/core/docker-sandbox/Dockerfile .
scripts.sandbox:build:k8s: docker build --platform linux/$(uname -m | sed 's/x86_64/amd64/' | sed 's/aarch64/arm64/') --target squad -t tau-sandbox:latest -f packages/k8s-sandbox/Dockerfile .
scripts.sandbox:build:k8s:agent: docker build --platform linux/$(uname -m | sed 's/x86_64/amd64/' | sed 's/aarch64/arm64/') --target agent -t tau-sandbox-agent:latest -f packages/k8s-sandbox/Dockerfile .
scripts.sandbox:build:k8s:all: bun run sandbox:build:k8s:agent && bun run sandbox:build:k8s
scripts.core:build: docker build --platform linux/$(uname -m | sed 's/x86_64/amd64/' | sed 's/aarch64/arm64/') -t tau-core:latest .
scripts.build:web: bun run --filter web build && bash scripts/sync-web-dist-if-configured.sh
scripts.test: bun run test:db:up && bun run --filter '*' test
scripts.k8s:pods: bash -c 'NS=${1:?Pass an instance namespace suffix}; KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tau-config kubectl -n tau-core-$NS get pods && echo && KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tau-config kubectl -n tau-sandboxes-$NS get pods' --
scripts.k8s:status: bash -c 'NS=${1:?Pass an instance namespace suffix}; export KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tau-config; echo "=== Core (tau-core-$NS) ==="; kubectl -n tau-core-$NS get pods,svc,ingress; echo; echo "=== Sandboxes (tau-sandboxes-$NS) ==="; kubectl -n tau-sandboxes-$NS get pods,pvc' --
scripts.k8s:logs:api: bash -c 'NS=${1:?Pass an instance namespace suffix}; KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tau-config kubectl -n tau-core-$NS logs -f --tail 200 deployment/tau-api' --
scripts.k8s:logs:worker: bash -c 'NS=${1:?Pass an instance namespace suffix}; KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tau-config kubectl -n tau-core-$NS logs -f --tail 200 deployment/tau-worker' --
scripts.k8s:restart: bash -c 'NS=${1:?Pass an instance namespace suffix}; KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tau-config kubectl -n tau-core-$NS rollout restart deployment tau-api tau-worker' --
scripts.k8s:restart:api: bash -c 'NS=${1:?Pass an instance namespace suffix}; KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tau-config kubectl -n tau-core-$NS rollout restart deployment tau-api' --
scripts.k8s:restart:worker: bash -c 'NS=${1:?Pass an instance namespace suffix}; KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tau-config kubectl -n tau-core-$NS rollout restart deployment tau-worker' --
scripts.k8s:shell:api: bash -c 'NS=${1:?Pass an instance namespace suffix}; KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tau-config kubectl -n tau-core-$NS exec -it deployment/tau-api -- sh' --
scripts.k8s:shell:worker: bash -c 'NS=${1:?Pass an instance namespace suffix}; KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tau-config kubectl -n tau-core-$NS exec -it deployment/tau-worker -- sh' --
scripts.k8s:down: bash -c 'NS=${1:?Pass an instance namespace suffix}; KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tau-config kubectl -n tau-core-$NS scale deployment tau-api tau-worker --replicas=0; echo "API and worker scaled to 0"' --
scripts.k8s:up: bash -c 'NS=${1:?Pass an instance namespace suffix}; KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tau-config kubectl -n tau-core-$NS scale deployment tau-api tau-worker --replicas=1; echo "API and worker scaled to 1"' --
scripts.k8s:describe: bash -c 'NS=${1:?Pass an instance namespace suffix}; KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tau-config kubectl -n tau-core-$NS describe pods' --
scripts.k8s:events: bash -c 'NS=${1:?Pass an instance namespace suffix}; KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tau-config kubectl -n tau-core-$NS get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -30' --
scripts.k8s:secrets: bash -c 'NS=${1:?Pass an instance namespace suffix}; KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tau-config kubectl -n tau-core-$NS get secret tau-core-secrets -o json | jq -r ".data | keys[]"' --
scripts.k8s:db:url: bash -c 'NS=${1:?Pass an instance namespace suffix}; KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tau-config kubectl -n tau-core-$NS get secret tau-core-secrets -o jsonpath="{.data.DATABASE_URL}" | base64 -d; echo' --
scripts.k8s:sandbox:pods: bash -c 'NS=${1:?Pass an instance namespace suffix}; KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tau-config kubectl -n tau-sandboxes-$NS get pods -o wide' --
scripts.k8s:sandbox:logs: bash -c 'NS=${1:?Pass an instance namespace suffix}; POD=${2:-$(KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tau-config kubectl -n tau-sandboxes-$NS get pods --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp -o jsonpath="{.items[-1].metadata.name}" 2>/dev/null)}; [ -z "$POD" ] && echo "No sandbox pods in tau-sandboxes-$NS" && exit 1; echo "Tailing $POD"; KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tau-config kubectl -n tau-sandboxes-$NS logs -f --tail 200 $POD' --
scripts.k8s:sandbox:kill: bash -c 'NS=${1:?Pass an instance namespace suffix}; KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tau-config kubectl -n tau-sandboxes-$NS delete pods --all --force; echo "All sandbox pods killed in tau-sandboxes-$NS"' --
scripts.k8s:ingress: KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tau-config kubectl -n ingress-nginx get svc ingress-nginx-controller
